claims: Continue invasive mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings (P-CMV, PEEP 5, FiO2 40%) and monitor airway pressures and oxygenation.
Monitor liver function with serial AST/ALT, bilirubin, INR, and fibrinogen given markedly elevated transaminases and coagulopathy.
Monitor coagulation status with serial PT/INR, PTT, fibrinogen, and platelet count given INR 3, PTT 78.7, fibrinogen 46, and platelets 123.
Continue hemodynamic monitoring and vasopressor support as ordered, with arterial line and CVP monitoring.
Monitor renal function with serial creatinine and urine output given creatinine rising to 2.4 mg/dL.
Monitor serum lactate and acid-base status with serial arterial blood gases and lactate levels.
Monitor blood glucose with fingerstick checks and continue insulin therapy as ordered given hyperglycemia.
Monitor electrolytes (potassium, magnesium, phosphate, calcium) with serial laboratory testing and replace as ordered.
Monitor neurologic status with serial Richmond-RAS and CAM-ICU assessments given altered mental status and light sedation.
Perform daily chest imaging and monitor ventilator parameters given mechanical ventilation and critical illness.
